meta.scope: Discounted Steam game products whose individual offer is verified or event-grounded to end October 1, 2026. DLC, soundtracks, demos, ordinary bundles, free base games, and full-price event participants are excluded.
meta.method: Title-first discovery across Steam specials, direct Steam offer pages, and October 1 sale-event inventories. Direct offer expiry overrides event membership.
meta.important: Snapshot for Oct 1, 2026. Event participation alone is not treated as a discount. The catalog favors coverage while preserving ends_at and verification provenance for each row.
meta.link_policy: Steam search links are generated client-side from each game title; app IDs are intentionally not required.
